issues.explanation: sendInvite, cancelInvite, openMember, saveRole, confirmRemoval, cancelRemoval and removeMember are all // placeholder with no logic.
accept and decline are placeholders, so invitee check, expiry, idempotency, membership creation and redirects are missing.
Members view was gutted to a bare div, missing invite form, pending list, members list, member modal and removal modal.
Pending invites view has only a title, missing invite list and Accept/Decline buttons.
Mailable uses deprecated build() so content()->markdown contract fails, and subject/role handling does not use the required translation keys.
Invite email view misses greeting, translated role via ui.role_*, expiry date and Team signature structure.
No switcher page, onboarding hr/title/buttons, routes, audit log, queued mail dispatch, rate limiter or race-safe unique handling appears in the diff.
Livewire validation uses legacy protected $rules instead of #[Validate] plus $this->validate().
Entity context is a writable public $entity instead of #[Locked] Entity, allowing client tampering.
Mailable implements build() instead of envelope()/content() with markdown => emails.entity-invite.
Factory has no Database\Factories namespace and imports App\Enums\UserRole while the model casts to App\Models\UserRole, so EntityInvite::factory() cannot resolve.
Locale files were added under resources/lang/ instead of lang/*.json so Laravel will not load them.
Mount authorizes only view, so employees can reach the manager-only members page.
All mutating actions perform no server-side authorization, validation or rate limiting.
Accept and decline perform no invitee email-match authorization, expiry check or membership scoping.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests were added for invites, mail, authorization or tamper cases.
Placeholder methods, lost return types and Layout, and inconsistent UserRole imports leave dead code that is hard to maintain.
Removed page Layout and prior members UI without replacement, slightly beyond the minimal task change.

conventions.evidence: Members.php:36-39 uses protected $rules not #[Validate]; Members.php:45 public $entity not #[Locked]; EntityInviteMail.php:31-35 uses build() not content()/envelope(); EntityInviteFactory.php:1-27 wrong namespace and App\Enums\UserRole vs App\Models\UserRole; locales under resources/lang/ not lang/

readability.evidence: Members.php:56-163 seven // placeholder methods; lost :View/:void types and #[Layout]; EntityInvite.php:275 vs factory import mismatch; dead placeholder comments

requirements.evidence: Members.php:56-163 and PendingInvites.php:9-17 all actions are // placeholder; members.blade.php:1-4 gutted to bare div; emails/entity-invite.blade.php:1-11 missing greeting/expiry/translated role; no switcher/onboarding/routes/audit/rate-limit in diff

scope.evidence: Every file in change.diff (Members, PendingInvites, EntityInvite, Entity::invites, migration, mail, views, langs) serves the invite/members task; no unrelated features added

security.evidence: Members.php:48-53 Gate::authorize('view') not manager-only; Members.php:56-163 and PendingInvites.php:9-17 have no $this->authorize/$this->validate/RateLimiter; public $entity writable with no #[Locked]

simplicity.evidence: No new abstractions or duplication; Members.php:56-163 and PendingInvites.php:9-17 are minimal stubs, but minimal without working

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no *Test.php, no Pest coverage for happy path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper cases

review.summary: The change scaffolds EntityInvite, its migration, relation, langs and mail/view stubs but leaves every Livewire action as a placeholder, so the invite flow, manager-only gate, emails and modals do not work. It also regresses conventions and security (no #[Validate]/#[Locked], deprecated mailable API, broken factory namespace, missing authorization). Reject until the actions, UI, mail content and tests are implemented.
